selection: Sort all tracked SQL files by byte size then path; take indices floor(n/4), floor(n/2), floor(3n/4), n-1. Preserve full files without editing. Selection frozen before candidate results.
hypothesis: Reject impossible dollar-delimiter syntax before scanning the SQL prefix; preserve every extraction fact and diagnostic.
procedure: For each complete source sample, copy once into a dedicated external input directory preserving its repository-relative path; use that same source directory for both binaries. Three fresh-output CLI extractions per binary, alternating old/new order by repeat. No cached output reuse. Same --code-only --no-viz --store sqlite options. Timeout and stream failures stay visible; no latency ratio if either observation is unavailable. Retain commands, wall time, outputs and graph digests. Full graph JSON and published canonical graph digests are compared; any nondeterministic metadata exclusion must be reported.
fullRepositoryFollowup: After correctness checks, rerun Compass CloudStack on its original complete source, same 1200-second extraction limit and 256 MiB graph admission rule. Do not substitute sample results or rewrite the original failed run. No controlled Graphify speed claim from this diagnosis.
scope: Development diagnosis of observed extraction bottleneck; not release-performance qualification, held-out evaluation, or god-object classification improvement.
